units.source_text: 对我来说，这次游山的回忆是苦楚的。

en.t: For me, the memory of this outing was a painful one.

units.source_text: 不管怎样，我们游山的一行人都是年轻人，

en.t: In any case, all of us on that outing were young,

units.source_text: 可是青春年华所特有的暗淡、浮躁、不安和虚无感，给游山这一天无处不涂上了彩色。

en.t: yet the gloom, restlessness, unease, and sense of emptiness peculiar to youth colored every corner of that day in the hills.

units.source_text: 无疑，柏木是估计到这一切，才选择那种阴郁天气的日子。

en.t: Without a doubt, Kashiwagi had foreseen all this, and that was why he chose a day with such gloomy weather.
